chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: How the Ink Spots began
summary: After the band breaks up Mosley introduces Charlie Fuqua to Deke Watson in Cleveland, leading to the original Ink Spots.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Let me tell you, I'm the cause of the Ink Spots being together; that's an interesting story.
Do you want me to tell you about it now?
We were playing around Massachusetts and New Lebanon, New York; that's where the Showboat was.
At that time, Lacey got this trouble and there was this thing called Charlie and Jerry.
They had a little act, so we got them and Charlie would play the guitar and Jerry would stand up in front of the band. We always liked to have somebody up front.
We played this hotel in Albany--the
What about Swan Lake, were you playing Swan Lake?
Oh, we played that. Those were one nighters. We played Swan Lake and quite a few places.

When the band broke up--we also played the Hilltop there in Schenectady--the Hilltop is the name of the club--Well anyway, how the Inkspots were started, when the band broke up, I had this car and Charlie Fuqua and Jerry, Jeter, Pillars and Chester Clark and myself got in my car and we all decided to go back to Cleveland, because we had been there.
I know, you were playing the Plantation.
We had been at the Plantation.
So anyway, I guess they can straighten the continuity out, anyway, we decided to go back to Cleveland and I introduced Charlie Fuqua to Deke Watson in the Majestic Hotel--we all

stayed there, and they started (inaudible). There was Charlie, Jerry and Deke, and then they went down to Cincinatti and got Hoppy (phonetic spelling) and then they went onto New York and went on from there and that's how the original Inkspots were born.
